selection_disclosure: Every V1-V3 quote, basis sample and relation episode is excluded. The score-approved cohort and strict greater-than-0.80 discovery rule were chosen before this boundary. A score is not a payoff proof and may not be relabelled as risk-free arbitrage.
hypothesis: For prospectively selected, rule-compatible cross-venue pairs, persistent executable probability dislocations may converge slowly enough to monetize after all four taker fees, displayed-depth limits and non-atomic leg-risk stress. Separately, content-hash-certified payoff relations may occasionally produce a terminal lock.

certified_terminal_lock.eligibility: exact identifiers, current rule-document hashes and deterministic statewise payoff proof
certified_terminal_lock.claim: minimum terminal payout may be called locked only after both simulated legs fill

score_approved_convergence.eligibility: strict match score greater than 0.80, no hard mismatch or rejection, operator paper approval, fresh synchronized books
score_approved_convergence.claim: risky convergence hypothesis only; no identity, parity or terminal-payout claim

synchronization.causality: latest state from each venue available at the decision cut; never backward-search for a favorable pair

execution.entry: walk equal share quantity through both executable ask books
execution.costs: all four venue taker fees plus one adverse tick per leg stress
execution.capital: $500 total with $250 per venue and displayed-depth/minimum-size constraints
execution.jurisdiction: paper observation only; no Kalshi trading path on the Dublin host

evaluation.independent_unit: first eligible episode per match_id, direction and UTC day
evaluation.selection_correction: Report certified and score-approved cohorts separately and correct across direction, horizon and all reviewed matching variants.
evaluation.null_outcome: No terminal locks or no post-fee convergence is a valid result.
